The fix is complete. Summary of changes in `crates/nu-command/src/strings/split/column.rs`:

- Added a `-n`/`--number` named flag (`SyntaxShape::Int`) to the signature, mirroring `split row` (crates/nu-command/src/strings/split/column.rs:28-32)
- Captured `max_split: Option<usize>` in both `run` and `run_const`, threaded it through `Arguments` into `split_column_helper`, which now uses `regex.splitn(..., max_split)` when set — so the nth column contains the remainder of the string — and falls back to `regex.split` otherwise
- Added an example: `'a--b--c' | split column -n 2 '--'` → `column1=a`, `column2=b--c`

Verification:
- `cargo test -p nu-command --test main split` — all 9 tests pass, including the new `to_column` case (`split column -n 3 ","` → `column3` = `tariff_item,name,origin`)
- `cargo test -p nu-command --lib split` — 11 pass, including `test_examples` for both `split column` and `split row`
- Full `--test main` run: 1629 passed; the 3 failures (`cd_permission_denied_folder`, `rm_prints_filenames_on_error`, `external_arg_expand_tilde`) are environment-related (running as root in the container) and unrelated to this change
- Manually verified the issue's use cases: `split column -n 2 ':'` and `split column -n 2 -r '\s+'` both put the remainder into the last column
